body:
When a task has two validations with Material or Needs decision findings, or two amendments that replace criteria, print the approved three questions at both idle and merge checks. At three, require a chief-engineer call or waiver before the merge ask; preserve the existing model floor and date rules. Validation and amendment counts stay separate, fenced examples do not count, and fourth occurrences require no second call.

Stack this Draft PR on `spacedock-ensign/model-roster-question-needs-both-families` (PR #765), base `e2eb2fb5a9629f52ab540fac1e274c287913cfac`. The change touches the seven approved files, amends ADR 0026, leaves standing workflow text and versions unchanged from that base, and retains the separate engineering-reviewer amendment event.

Validation:

- All 284 focused tests passed; eight historical replays and three first-occurrence byte comparisons matched the design.
- All six behavioral mutations were rejected; the standing-text mutation and ADR-omission comparison were exercised. A comparison of 186 committed tasks found 12 changed outputs, all at approved thresholds.
- Skill lint, ADR lint, number guards and comment-ratio check passed; output measured 51 words for the advisory and 68/73 for the owed call.
- The full package run completed 26 commands: 25 passed. `test_poc_readme.py::DeriveTests.test_only_the_ideation_entry_and_section_are_removed` fails because the parent adds `model: opus` before `gate: true`; the identical failure was reproduced from an untouched assigned-base archive. That file is outside this task's approved scope. Native dispatch/recovery checks used installed Spacedock 0.27.3; CI pins 0.27.2.
- RoboRev: `incomplete: the roborev daemon is not running` (exit 3). FO owns exact-head review and hosted CI after publication. CI cost per PR was not measured; no CI trigger changed.

Candidate: `92dbf1d32c7142e010fad6a7d9807a17ae0ce240`.
